summary: Senegal’s mixed agriculture-and-restoration pledges cover 99,621 ha under assisted natural regeneration and 4,500 ha under compost by 2030, plus 498,105 ha of regeneration and 14,400 ha of compost. They also target conversion of 28,500 ha of irrigated rice—about 0.47% of current agricultural area—to the System of Rice Intensification. Restoration targets 500,000 ha of plantations plus 1,297 ha of mangroves and 21,000 ha of other plantations annually; another passage specifies 4,000 ha of mangroves per year. Conservation includes protecting 500,000 ha, about 9.1% of current mapped forest; establishing 10 marine protected areas by 2025 and 15 MPAs; reducing the deforestation rate by 25% to 30,000 ha/year by 2030; and reducing areas burned by 5%, 10%, and about 90%. Related measures distribute 800,000 improved stoves annually by 2030, with another passage citing 1.5 million, and install 27,000 biodigesters, with a higher biodigester commitment of more than 48,000.
